description: SHA-256 pins of the two public Google identifiers a Google Play build (productionRelease) must carry. googleDriveClientIdSha256: the Google Drive backup OAuth client ID (SORA_GOOGLE_TOKEN_PROD), which must be the client 3.8.6.3 used or people cannot see their existing Drive backups. While it is empty, every productionRelease build is refused. firebaseAppIdSha256: the Firebase app ID (mobilesdk_app_id) of jp.co.soramitsu.sora in google-services.json; checked when it is set. Both IDs are inside every released APK, so they are not secrets; only their hashes are stored. scripts/google-identity-pin.py prints the values to put here (see scripts/README.md). scripts/verify-production-google-identity.gradle enforces them.

provenance.source: Google Play signed APKs 3.8.6.2 (121) and 3.8.6.3 (122), verified 2026-10-12
provenance.historicalDriveClientContinuity: classes3.dex: jp.co.soramitsu.xbackup.repository.m.<init> passes the pinned client to GoogleSignInOptions.Builder.requestIdToken; both APKs match. requestEmail and drive.appdata scope remain unchanged.
provenance.firebaseSource: The official Firebase Console jp.co.soramitsu.sora configuration (sora-passport-id), downloaded 2026-10-12, has the same Firebase app ID as resources.arsc in both Play APKs.
provenance.androidOAuthBinding: Verify jp.co.soramitsu.sora plus Play app-signing certificate binding in the historical Drive client project. The downloaded Firebase configuration has no type-1 entry; it does not establish this binding.
